mapper.update:
/* userDAO.updateUserInfo */ UPDATE member.user_info
user_pw = #{userPw},
name = #{name},
email = #{email},
phone = #{phone},
birth_dt = #{birthDt},
WHERE seq = #{seq}
mapper.select: /* userDAO.selectTodo */ SELECT seq, user_seq, title, memo, status, DATE_FORMAT(reg_dt, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as regDt, DATE_FORMAT(mod_dt, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as modDt, use_yn FROM member.user_todo WHERE 1 = 1 AND user_seq = #{userSeq} AND use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY seq DESC
mapper.insert: /* userDAO.insertTodo */ INSERT INTO member.user_todo ( user_seq, title, memo, status, reg_dt, mod_dt, use_yn ) VALUES ( #{userSeq}, #{title}, #{memo}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW(), 'Y' )
